As part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Taris Resettlement Initiative|Resettlement Initiative]] for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a '''colony''' was started on the shores of [[Lake Brell]] under the leadership of [[Yelzrin]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the [[Desolator crisis]] of [[3643 BBY]], a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] by the name of [[Rora Seake]] was sent to destroy the colony, but she was defeated in a [[Duel in the Lake Brell colony bunker|duel]] by a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]].
